mapper.sql: p.id, p.post_no, p.publisher_id, p.item_type, p.status, p.title, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.item_name, p.description, p.public_features, p.private_features, p.occurred_at, p.campus_area, p.location_name, p.color, p.brand, p.contact_hint, p.view_count, p.published_at, p.completed_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_post ( post_no, publisher_id, item_type, status, title, category_id, item_name, description, public_features, private_features, occurred_at, campus_area, location_name, color, brand, contact_hint, view_count, published_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{postNo}, #{publisherId}, #{itemType}, #{status}, #{title}, #{categoryId}, #{itemName}, #{description}, #{publicFeatures}, #{privateFeatures}, #{occurredAt}, #{campusArea}, #{locationName}, #{color}, #{brand}, #{contactHint}, 0, #{publishedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM item_post p JOIN item_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM item_post p JOIN item_category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE ORDER BY COALESCE(p.published_at, p.created_at) DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM item_post p WHERE
mapper.update: UPDATE item_post SET title = #{post.title}, category_id = #{post.categoryId}, item_name = #{post.itemName}, description = #{post.description}, public_features = #{post.publicFeatures}, private_features = #{post.privateFeatures}, occurred_at = #{post.occurredAt}, campus_area = #{post.campusArea}, location_name = #{post.locationName}, color = #{post.color}, brand = #{post.brand}, contact_hint = #{post.contactHint}, updated_by = #{publisherId} WHERE id = #{post.id} AND publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'SEARCHING')
UPDATE item_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE item_post SET status = 'CLAIM_VERIFYING' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'SEARCHING'
